name: Children Responsibility
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as His reward. The responsibility of parents is to diligently train and correct their children, guiding them in the way they should go so they will not depart from it in later life. Discipline, including correction and reproof, is necessary to impart wisdom and bring delight to the soul of the parent. Furthermore, children are commanded to obey and honor their parents, which is affirmed as right and accompanied by a promise, underscoring the divine order within the family.
